Marta: Hey team — quick sync on the elasticity contract matrix customers asked for. We need a proposal that covers short bursts (<=5m), soft-burst guarantees, and graceful fallback. 
Kevin: Do we have a concrete example SLA shape from sales? 
Marta: Sales sent an ask: "5‑minute bursts up to 3x baseline throughput, up to 10 times/month, plus predictable throttling beyond that". They want clear billing/penalty rules. 
Jun: Sounds like we should map that to a headroom credit model, not hard reserved GPUs. Otherwise cost balloons. 
Ally: +1. Headroom credits with spillover rules. Also requires per-tenant observability for consumed credits. 
Kevin: For fallbacks, propose: 1) immediately route to cheaper model variant, 2) degrade QoS (shorter generation max tokens), 3) queue with 95p latency target. 
Marta: I like 1+2 as primary; queue as last resort. Need to define SLOs for each step. 
Jun: Implementation note: autoscaler can preempt opportunistic capacity using credit score. If credit balance > threshold, allow burst. 
Ally: What about customer opt-in for strict guarantees (reserved pool attach) vs soft-burst? We need clear tradeoffs for contracts. 
Marta: Yep — two offers: "Soft Elasticity" (credits + best-effort fallback) vs "Burst Reserved" (hard commit, billed higher, guaranteed preemption protection). 
Kevin: Launch criteria proposal: (a) config UI to set offer, (b) per-tenant credit ledger exposed, (c) rollout to pilot customers, (d) end-to-end billing test, (e) OSS docs & playbook. 
Jun: For metrics: credit_issued, credit_consumed, burst_success_rate, fallback_rate, p95_latency_during_burst. 
Ally: Add cost-per-token delta for burst vs baseline; sales will ask. 
Marta: Customer negotiation note: sales wants a simple sentence for contract "X guaranteed burst minutes per billing period". We should agree to rounding rules and prorating. 
Kevin: Edge cases: if infra loses region capacity during a burst, fallback path must be automatic cross-region failover or immediate downgrade. Can we promise cross-region? 
Jun: Cross-region failover is operationally risky. Recommend auto-downgrade to model-variant in same region + async replication for metrics. 
Ally: Ops needs prewarm signals to avoid cold starts when we allow big bursts. Prewarm hooks: >2 requests/min for 1 min triggers warm. 
Marta: Action items: Kevin draft SLA wording + penalty matrix; Jun prototype credit ledger + autoscale gating; Ally list required observability panels and prewarm hooks; I'll coordinate pilot scoping with sales. 
ops-bot: NOTE: Capacity maintenance window scheduled 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC — may affect pilot region. :warning: 
Kevin: I'll start a one-pager. Can we discuss billing model options: per-minute credit vs per-token credit? 
Jun: Per-token aligns to unit economics; per-minute aligns to throughput guarantees. We can do hybrid: issue tokens normalized to throughput. 
Ally: UX question: how would tenants see projected credit burn for a prompt? We need a simulator in console. 
Marta: Good call. Add simulator to launch checklist. 
Kevin: Estimated timeline: prototype in 3 sprints, pilot with 1-2 customers in sprint 6. 
Marta: OK — sync next Tue 10am to review SLA draft. Keep notes here. :thumbsup:
